lessons.title: Question: Parameter
lessons.interactiveContent:
Why would we use a function's parameter as part of a nested conditional's condition?

To reuse the conditional for whatever value we call the function withTo avoid getting an errorWe can't use function parameters as part of conditions

To reuse the conditional for whatever value we call the function with.
lessons.hardModeContent:
We use a function's parameter as part of a nested condition to reuse the conditional for whatever value we call the function with.

Why can show_discount(50) and show_discount(150) take different branches?

The parameter receives each argument, and the conditional checks that value.The conditional ignores the arguments and chooses a branch randomly.Each function can use its parameter in a condition only once.

The parameter receives each argument, and the conditional checks that value.

Passing a list as an argument works the same way as passing any other value.
